mainText: <speak><voice name="Joanna">Hey Verona, let's get into the dish! At 10 PM, the sky is crystal clear by the Military Ridge State Trail under a beautiful full moon. The overnight low will hit 69 degrees with no rain, though there are no visible ISS passes tonight.</voice></speak>

<speak><voice name="Salli">We are getting creative in the city as the Clerk's office launches a fun contest for students to design our very own I Voted stickers for the upcoming November election.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Justin">Get moving today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, then gear up for a trivia-packed tomorrow with options at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Kimberly">In a rather wild turn of events last Thursday, officers had to handle a domestic disturbance on Lucerne Drive that resulted in an arrest.</voice></speak>
<speak><voice name="Joey">Treat yourself to the incredible Snickers Swirl flavor today, it is the perfect way to satisfy your sweet tooth.</voice></speak>
